title: The Next 100
tagline: A living forecast of the next 100 years of humanity. It checks the news every week and grades itself.

hinge.pluralism: Capability stays contested across many actors and open models. A chaotic but pluralistic world.
hinge.concentration: One or two actors consolidate a decisive, compounding lead. The branch that produces the century's best or worst outcomes.

forces.name: AI compounds; institutions lag
forces.text: Capability runs 5 to 15 years ahead of adoption by governments, courts, schools and firms. The gap is where the turbulence lives.

forces.name: Demographic decline is the slowest, most certain force
forces.text: It barely matters in the 2020s and dominates the 2060s: who works, who cares for whom, who pays.

forces.name: Concentration vs. pluralism is the hinge
forces.text: Whether the most capable systems end up in a few hands or many decides whether the 2040s look like a renaissance or a lockdown.

caveat: Long-range probabilities are subjective judgments, not calibrated scientific estimates. Each date is explicitly a deadline, window, approximate year or through-date. Versioned resolution rules define the test; narrative scenarios without an agreed test are excluded from scoring.
